name: ur10
_dh_source: Universal Robots official Modified-DH parameters (UR10), see https://www.universal-robots.com/articles/ur/application-installation/dh-parameters-for-calculations-of-kinematics-and-dynamics/.  Order: alpha_{i-1}, a_{i-1}, d_i, theta_i.
_joint_limits_note: Default UR10 spec is +/- 2*pi but we cap at +/- pi to disable the rotational ambiguity; the IIWA14 Z4 cache assumption (joint-0 has 90-degree symmetry) does NOT apply to UR10 because the base-twist alpha=0 produces no symmetry; experiments must set z4_enabled=false.
link_radii_comment: Conservative outer-bound capsule radii (m) per joint+tool. Length 7 = 6 joints + 1 tool slot. The active-link map (defined by zero-length skipping in pack_arrays) keeps every joint with non-zero a or d.
